ns2:section.sectionText: This fast-paced, hands-on course has students plan, develop and execute an innovative advertising campaign for a real client. Simulates a modern agency experience that requires creative problem solving, design thinking, data literacy and professionalism. Students can hone specialized skills and expertise in research, strategy, creative media and/or leadership. 3 undergraduate hours. Prerequisites: ADV 283 and 284 or instructor approval. Meets with ADV 490 SS (62646).
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Advertising major(s). Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
